vsm2.17:41.3: Seyyathidaṃ, ‘‘iti kho, bhikkhave, avijjūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārūpanisaṃ viññāṇa’’ntiādi (saṃ. ni. 2.23).
vsm2.17:41.4: Tathā ‘‘upādāniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati, taṇhāpaccayā upādāna’’ntiādi (saṃ. ni. 2.52).
vsm2.17:41.6: Seyyathidaṃ, ‘‘avijjānīvaraṇassa, bhikkhave, bālassa taṇhāya sampayuttassa evamayaṃ kāyo samudāgato.
vsm2.17:41.7: Iti ayañceva kāyo bahiddhā ca nāmarūpaṃ itthetaṃ dvayaṃ.
vsm2.17:41.8: Dvayaṃ paṭicca phasso saḷevāyatanāni, yehi phuṭṭho bālo sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedetī’’tiādi (saṃ. ni. 2.19).
vsm2.17:42.1: Tāsu desanāsu ‘‘avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’’ti ayamidha avijjāvasena ekadhammamūlikā desanāti veditabbā.
vsm2.17:43.2: Seyyathidaṃ, pūretuṃ ayuttaṭṭhena kāyaduccaritādi avindiyaṃ nāma, aladdhabbanti attho.
vsm2.17:43.4: Tabbiparītato kāyasucaritādi vindiyaṃ nāma, taṃ vindiyaṃ na vindatīti avijjā.
vsm2.17:43.5: Khandhānaṃ rāsaṭṭhaṃ, āyatanānaṃ āyatanaṭṭhaṃ, dhātūnaṃ suññaṭṭhaṃ,
vsm2.17:43.6: indriyānaṃ adhipatiyaṭṭhaṃ, saccānaṃ tathaṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ karotītipi avijjā.
vsm2.17:43.7: Dukkhādīnaṃ pīḷanādivasena vuttaṃ catubbidhaṃ atthaṃ aviditaṃ karotītipi avijjā.
vsm2.17:43.9: Paramatthato avijjamānesu itthipurisādīsu javati, vijjamānesupi khandhādīsu na javatīti avijjā.
vsm2.17:43.10: Apica cakkhuviññāṇādīnaṃ vatthārammaṇānaṃ paṭiccasamuppādapaṭiccasamuppannānañca dhammānaṃ chādanatopi avijjā.
vsm2.17:44.3: Etīti uppajjati ceva pavattati cāti attho.
vsm2.17:44.5: Avijjā ca sā paccayo cāti avijjāpaccayo. Tasmā avijjāpaccayā.
vsm2.17:44.7: Apica avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārasaddena āgatasaṅkhārāti duvidhā saṅkhārā.
vsm2.17:44.8: Tattha puññāpuññāneñjābhisaṅkhārā tayo, kāyavacīcittasaṅkhārā tayoti ime cha avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā.
vsm2.17:45.4: payogābhisaṅkhāroti ime pana cattāro saṅkhāra-saddena āgatasaṅkhārā.
vsm2.17:46.1: Tattha ‘‘aniccā vata saṅkhārā’’tiādīsu (dī. ni. 2.221, 272; saṃ. ni. 1.186) vuttā sabbepi sappaccayā dhammā saṅkhatasaṅkhārā nāma.
vsm2.17:46.2: Kammanibbattā tebhūmakā rūpārūpadhammā abhisaṅkhatasaṅkhārāti aṭṭhakathāsu vuttā,
vsm2.17:46.3: tepi ‘‘aniccā vata saṅkhārā’’ti (dī. ni. 2.221; 272; saṃ. ni. 1.186) ettheva saṅgahaṃ gacchanti.
vsm2.17:46.4: Visuṃ pana nesaṃ āgataṭṭhānaṃ na paññāyati.
vsm2.17:46.6: tassa ‘‘avijjāgatoyaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo puññañceva saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharotī’’tiādīsu (saṃ. ni. 2.51) āgataṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.
vsm2.17:46.8: so ‘‘yāvatikā abhisaṅkhārassa gati, tāvatikā gantvā akkhāhataṃ maññe aṭṭhāsī’’tiādīsu (a. ni. 3.15) āgato.
vsm2.17:47.2: ‘‘saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuno paṭhamaṃ nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato cittasaṅkhāro’’tiādinā (ma. ni. 1.464) nayena saṅkhāra-saddena āgatā aneke saṅkhārā.
vsm2.17:47.3: Tesu natthi so saṅkhāro, yo saṅkhatasaṅkhārehi saṅgahaṃ na gaccheyya,
vsm2.17:48.1: ito paraṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇantiādīsu vuttaṃ vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.17:48.16: Dukkhayatīti dukkhaṃ. Uppādaṭṭhitivasena vā dvidhā khaṇatītipi dukkhaṃ.
vsm2.17:49.1: Na kevalañca sokādīheva, atha kho sabbapadehi sambhavanti-saddassa yojanā kātabbā.
vsm2.17:49.2: Itarathā hi ‘‘avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’’ti vutte kiṃ karontīti na paññāyeyya,
vsm2.17:49.3: sambhavantīti pana yojanāya sati avijjā ca sā paccayo cāti avijjāpaccayo.
vsm2.17:49.4: Tasmā avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā sambhavantīti paccayapaccayuppannavavatthānaṃ kataṃ hoti.
vsm2.17:50.2: Tena avijjādīheva kāraṇehi, na issaranimmānādīhīti dasseti.
vsm2.17:50.5: Dukkhakkhandhassāti dukkhasamūhassa, na sattassa, na sukhasubhādīnaṃ.
vsm2.17:52.7: Dvārārammaṇato pana sabbesupi arūpadhammesu chabbidhatā veditabbā.
vsm2.17:56.4: Yonigatipariyāpannato catubbidhaṃ pañcavidhañcāti iminā nayena phassādīnampi ekavidhādibhāvo veditabbo
vsm2.17:57.1: 590.Aṅgānañca vavatthānāti sokādayo cettha bhavacakkassa avicchedadassanatthaṃ vuttā.
vsm2.17:57.3: Yathāha – ‘‘assutavā, bhikkhave, puthujjano sārīrikāya dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati
vsm2.17:57.5: Yāva ca tesaṃ pavatti, tāva avijjāyāti punapi avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti sambandhameva hoti bhavacakkaṃ.
vsm2.17:57.6: Tasmā tesaṃ jarāmaraṇeneva ekasaṅkhepaṃ katvā dvādaseva paṭiccasamuppādaṅgānīti veditabbāni.
